race.comment: MEDATSU (6) loomed strongly third up with a narrow fifth in a decent rating contest behind Pinhole over 1900m at Rosehill in BM88 grade. Ready to peak with the 54.5kg. UNLIMITED (3) meets CAVALRY MAN better at the weights after his tiring seventh over 2000m in the Toowoomba Cup. Was a month between runs on that occasion and strips fitter here. CAVALRY MAN (4) in career best form and defeated a strong line-up from the wide gate with a comfortable win over 2000m in the Toowoomba Cup. Can get cover from the gate and take holding out. FIOPROSPERO (10) comes here deep into the preparation and maps to get the right run on the limit weight. Savaged the line from last on the turn when third over 1900m at Canterbury in BM72 grade. Genuine each way contender.
